column1: # tests/deletes.tsv -- the deletion ledger (commissar ruling 2026-10-23, items 1 and 8): every deletion call site in the
# tracked tree.  guarded: it goes through the one guard include/unisa_safedel.h (the CLI tests/safedel.cx, cx_remove/
# cx_rmtree/cx_trash, unisa_safedel()) and has its mutation row in tests/deletemut.tsv (same file and line); PRIMITIVE is
# the guard form it uses.  exempt: a raw deletion primitive left in place, with the reason.  tests/deletecheck.cx scans the
# tree (git ls-files) and is red for a raw site not exempt here (counted per file and primitive), a stale row, a guard
# call without its row, and shell-concatenated rm outside product bytes.  LINE is where the site stood when the row was
# written; klass: own-mkdtemp own-mkstemp arg-derived env-derived fixed-repo-path fixture-repo product-internal corpus
# guard other; risk: low medium high.
